Atlanta Capital Group Has Lowered By $954,800 Its Facebook (FB) Position; Pioneer Floating Rate Trust Has 0.7 Sentiment
May 22, 2018 - By Clifton Ray
Atlanta Capital Group decreased Facebook Inc (FB) stake by 8.45% reported in 2017Q4 SEC filing. Atlanta Capital Group sold 5,425 shares as Facebook Inc (FB)’s stock declined 14.10%. The Atlanta Capital Group holds 58,781 shares with $10.37M value, down from 64,206 last quarter. Facebook Inc now has $533.03 billion valuation. The stock decreased 0.19% or $0.35 during the last trading session, reaching $184.15. About 8.63M shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% since May 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
